metric_policy.complete_package_note: Complete package includes generated MBIST wrappers, algorithms, saboteur/model RTL, and staged SRAM behavioral models.

registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Control register. Host programs launch policy and safe-clear behavior. Writes are accepted only when the controller is not busy, except clear_fault semantics which are handled by the dedicated pulse register behavior in hardware.

fields.name: CFG_VALID
fields.description: Configuration-valid indicator. Software may use this as a compact software-managed validity bit for the programmed CSR set.

fields.name: AUTO_CLEAR_FAULT
fields.description: Optional host policy bit indicating that software intends to request a clear-fault action when safe. Actual sticky-fault clearing remains controlled by the hardware clear_fault path.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: BUSY
fields.description: Controller busy.

fields.name: DONE
fields.description: Operation completed.

fields.name: FAULT
fields.description: Sticky fault indicator.

fields.name: TIMEOUT
fields.description: Timeout fault sticky bit.

fields.name: STALE
fields.description: Stale-command fault sticky bit.

fields.name: CLAMPED
fields.description: Clamp indicator.

fields.name: FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Safe fallback state active.

fields.name: TRANSPORT_ERROR
fields.description: Transport protocol error sticky bit.

registers.name: STATUS2
registers.description: Additional status bit for response validity.

fields.name: RESPONSE_VALID
fields.description: A bounded response has been accepted and parsed as command-relevant.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: SEQ_ID[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte of the configured sequence/tag value used by the launch and freshness path.

fields.name: SEQ_ID[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of the configured sequence/tag value.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_L
registers.description: Timeout threshold in ticks, low byte.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_TICKS[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte of the timeout watchdog threshold.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_H
registers.description: Timeout threshold in ticks, high byte.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_TICKS[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of the timeout watchdog threshold.

registers.name: FRESHNESS_L
registers.description: Freshness threshold in ticks, low byte.

fields.name: FRESHNESS_LIMIT[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte of the freshness threshold.

registers.name: FRESHNESS_H
registers.description: Freshness threshold in ticks, high byte.

fields.name: FRESHNESS_LIMIT[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of the freshness threshold.

fields.name: VELOCITY_MPS[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte of the configured velocity operating point.

fields.name: VELOCITY_MPS[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of the configured velocity operating point.

registers.name: GEOM_BASE_0
registers.description: Geometry base address byte 0, least significant.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_BASE_ADDR[7:0]
fields.description: Least significant byte of the external geometry base address.
